name: @pitzzahh/signaldb-adapter-tauri
description: A SignalDB persistence adapter for Tauri apps with optional encryption support

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/encryption.ts --outdir dist --target browser --minify --external @signaldb/core --external @tauri-apps/plugin-fs && tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.size: bun run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const z=require('zlib');for(const f of ['dist/index.js','dist/encryption.js']){const b=fs.statSync(f).size;const g=z.gzipSync(fs.readFileSync(f)).length;console.log(f+': '+b+' B, gzip: '+g+' B');if(b>15360){console.error('Bundle too large: '+f+' '+b+' B > 15360 B');process.exit(1)}}"
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run test

author: Peter John Arao <hello@peterjohnarao.com>
